text: My mental health has improved a lot, though it's hard to separate the effects of the experience from everything else I've done. Living with chronic pain had made me depressed and anxious, and I'd lost a lot of my sense of joy. Since the experience I feel much more at peace with my body and my illness. I'm less depressed, and I've found ways to enjoy life even on bad days. I appreciate the good days so much more now, and I notice small pleasures, like a warm bath, a good book, a phone call with a friend. I've also become more open to different approaches to managing my health, like yoga and pelvic floor physiotherapy, which have helped too. The online community I've joined has made me feel less alone, and I've made some real friends there. I feel a lot of love and gratitude for them.
Ich bin weniger ängstlich und kann Unsicherheit besser aushalten. Dadurch bin ich psychisch stabiler geworden und habe weniger Panikattacken. Ich fühle mich insgesamt sicherer in meinem Leben.

I'm much less anxious and I sleep better. I've realised how much of my life I was wasting on worry, and I'm trying to enjoy the present more. I appreciate my family and my home more than I used to, and I feel calmer and more content. My doctor has reduced my anxiety medication because I'm doing so well. I'm also more patient with myself when the worry does come back, which it sometimes does.
I'm happier and less anxious in general. I enjoy things more and I'm not as tense.

Meine psychische Gesundheit hat sich nach der Erfahrung langsam, aber stetig verbessert. Ich litt damals an einer schweren Erschöpfungsdepression und hatte das Gefühl, nie wieder gesund zu werden. Die Erfahrung hat mir einen Hoffnungsschimmer gegeben. Ich habe gespürt, dass in mir noch Lebensfreude und Kraft stecken, und ich habe verstanden, warum ich mich so lange überfordert habe. Mit Hilfe meiner Therapeutin habe ich an diesen Erkenntnissen weitergearbeitet. Heute geht es mir deutlich besser. Ich habe wieder Freude an Dingen, die mir früher wichtig waren, wie Gartenarbeit und Musik. Ich schlafe besser und habe mehr Energie. Vor allem habe ich gelernt, besser für mich zu sorgen, und ich weiß jetzt, dass ich nicht immer funktionieren muss. Ich bin dankbar für jeden guten Tag, und ich nehme die schönen Momente viel bewusster wahr als früher.

I'm more emotionally honest with myself and that has made me more stable. I don't have those sudden breakdowns anymore, because I deal with my feelings as they come. I understand myself better, and I'm less anxious. My friends have noticed that I'm more open and less guarded.

I'm much less resentful and lonely now that I communicate my needs. I used to feel invisible in my marriage, and that made me quite depressed. Now I feel heard and loved, and my mood has improved a lot. I understand myself and my patterns better, and I can see how my expectation that others should read my mind came from a childhood where I never felt safe asking for things.

Ich bin ruhiger und zufriedener geworden. Ich habe weniger Ängste und kann das Leben mehr genießen. Ich bin auch dankbarer für die Zeit, die ich noch mit meiner Mutter habe, und ich versuche, diese Zeit bewusst zu gestalten, statt mich nur über ihre Krankheit zu grämen.

My mental health has improved enormously since the experience and since coming out. Before, I was depressed and anxious most of the time, and I had a constant feeling that something was wrong with me. I didn't know what it was, I just felt like I was living in the wrong life. The experience showed me who I am, and coming out was the beginning of finally living as myself. My depression has lifted almost completely. I still have anxious moments, mostly about how people will treat me, but I feel at home in myself for the first time. I feel so much love, for myself, for my partner, for my trans friends who have become like a family. I'm also more open-minded than I used to be, about gender, about people, about life. I see how many ways there are to be human, and I find that beautiful. I'm grateful every day that I get to live as myself.
I'm less stressed and more content. I feel happier and more relaxed in my everyday life. My partner and I fight less, which helps a lot.

Ich bin psychisch stabiler, seit ich besser auf meinen Körper höre. Ich hatte früher oft depressive Phasen nach stressigen Zeiten, weil ich mich völlig verausgabt hatte. Das ist seltener geworden. Ich habe gelernt, rechtzeitig Pausen zu machen, und das tut mir sehr gut. Ich bin auch zufriedener und genieße die ruhigen Zeiten mehr. Ich verstehe jetzt besser, wie eng Körper und Psyche zusammenhängen, und das hat meine Einstellung zu Gesundheit verändert. Ich gehe regelmäßig in die Sauna und mache lange Spaziergänge im Wald, und ich merke, wie gut mir das tut. Insgesamt geht es mir viel besser als vor der Erfahrung.
I'm more detached from things in general. I don't feel as much, good or bad. I'm fine with it I guess.

My mental health has improved a lot since the experience and the changes I made afterwards. I was close to burning out, constantly anxious and exhausted, and I'd lost touch with any sense of joy. I didn't really notice how unhappy I was because I was too busy. Since the experience, I've slowed down, and I've rediscovered the joy of being with my kids, of having time to read, of cooking a proper meal. I appreciate my life so much more, and I'm much less anxious. I also feel more love for my family and for myself. I used to see myself as a machine that had to keep producing. Now I see myself as a person who deserves rest and care. I'm also more open to a different kind of life than the one I'd planned, maybe a less prestigious career, but a happier one. My husband says I'm like the person he married again.
Ich bin ausgeglichener und habe weniger Ärger in meinem Leben. Das tut mir psychisch sehr gut. Ich fühle mich in meinen Beziehungen sicherer und wohler.

My anxiety has improved a lot. I still have anxious thoughts, but they don't take over like they used to. I feel more in control and more confident. I'm also more open to doing things I used to avoid because of anxiety, like travelling and meeting new people.

I felt very happy and peaceful for maybe two or three weeks after the experience, like a weight had been lifted. But it faded, and now I'd say my mental health is about the same as before. I'm still anxious and I still struggle with low moods. I'm a bit disappointed, because I'd hoped it would last longer.

Meine psychische Gesundheit hat sich durch die Erfahrung sehr verbessert. Ich war lange Zeit unzufrieden und hatte das Gefühl, dass mein Leben an mir vorbeizieht. Ich hatte depressive Verstimmungen und eine ständige innere Unruhe, die ich mir nicht erklären konnte. Heute weiß ich, dass diese Unruhe daher kam, dass ich nicht das Leben gelebt habe, das ich leben wollte. Seit ich angefangen habe, mein Leben zu verändern, geht es mir viel besser. Ich bin zufriedener, mutiger und offener für Neues. Ich habe Freude an meiner Weiterbildung und freue mich auf den Umzug. Ich verstehe mich selbst besser und weiß, was mir wichtig ist. Ich bin auch dankbarer für mein Leben, weil ich gemerkt habe, dass ich es selbst gestalten kann. Das gibt mir ein Gefühl von Freiheit, das ich vorher nicht kannte.
I'm more emotionally balanced and less anxious. I feel more mature and in control of my reactions, which has made my relationships better and me happier.

My mental health has improved a lot. I was close to burnout, and I had started to feel numb and cynical about my work, which scared me, because I've always been passionate about it. Since the experience I've regained my sense of purpose and my compassion, without the overwhelming feeling of responsibility. I'm less anxious, I sleep better, and I'm more present with my own family. I also appreciate my life more, and I'm grateful for my own privileges, which I see more clearly after working with families in crisis. I feel a deep love for the work and the people I work with, and I'm more open to trusting my colleagues and the system, instead of feeling like I have to do everything myself.
Ich schlafe besser und bin weniger ängstlich. Mir geht es psychisch deutlich besser.

My mental health has been through a lot in the last few years, with my father's illness and death. I think the experience helped me get through it without falling into depression, which is what I was most afraid of. It gave me a sense of love and connection that I could come back to, even in the darkest moments. After my father died, I grieved, but it was a healthy grief. I could cry, I could talk about him, I could laugh about the good memories. I didn't shut down. I'm also more grateful for my own life and for the people in it. I've become closer to my siblings through all of this, and I appreciate them so much more. I feel more open to life and to whatever comes next, and I've started to think about what I want to do now that I'm not a carer anymore. I feel hopeful.
I'm less exhausted and more balanced, and I feel better about myself. Setting limits has really helped my mental health.

Ich bin psychisch ausgeglichener und streite weniger mit meinen Kindern. Das hat die Stimmung in unserer Familie sehr verbessert. Ich fühle mich wohler und habe mehr Freude am Familienleben. Ich bin dankbar für meine Kinder, auch wenn sie mich manchmal in den Wahnsinn treiben.
I feel more confident and less anxious. I trust myself more, and that's made me happier.

My mental health has improved enormously since the experience. I had been living with PTSD for over twenty years without really knowing it. I thought that being on edge all the time was just my personality. Since the experience, I feel safer in my body and in the world. I sleep better, I have fewer nightmares, and I don't startle as much. I can enjoy things now that I couldn't before, like going to a concert or walking in a crowded market. I feel a deep gratitude for my life and for the peace I have now. I also feel closer to my family, because we've started talking about the past, and that has healed something between us. I feel more love for them, and more love for myself. I understand myself better too. I see now that my hypervigilance was a survival strategy, and that it saved my life once, but that I don't need it anymore.

Ich bin ausgeglichener und habe weniger Stress. Meine Stimmung ist stabiler, und ich habe das Gefühl, mich besser zu kennen. Ich weiß jetzt, was mir guttut und was nicht, und richte mein Leben mehr danach aus. Die Meditation und die Waldspaziergänge sind mir sehr wichtig geworden.

I'm much less anxious and much more relaxed. I enjoy life more, and I'm more open to new experiences, because I'm not so scared of things going wrong. I've started travelling more, and I've become more spontaneous. I feel like I'm actually living my life instead of just trying to keep it under control. My friends say I'm much more fun to be around.
Honestly, I don't feel like it changed my mental health. I had a nice few days afterwards, but I'm the same person. I don't feel strongly about it either way anymore.

Meine psychische Gesundheit hat sich durch die Erfahrung deutlich verbessert, vor allem, weil ich mich nicht mehr so allein fühle. Ich hatte früher oft depressive Phasen, in denen ich mich zurückgezogen und niemanden an mich herangelassen habe. Ich habe immer gedacht, dass ich meine Probleme allein lösen muss. Seit der Erfahrung ist das anders. Ich spüre eine tiefe Verbundenheit mit meinen Freunden und meiner Familie, und ich traue mich, mich ihnen anzuvertrauen. Das hat mir sehr geholfen. Ich bin glücklicher und weniger ängstlich. Ich spüre mehr Liebe, für andere und für mich selbst, und ich bin dankbar für die Menschen in meinem Leben. Auch nach dem Jobverlust bin ich nicht in eine Depression gerutscht, weil ich wusste, dass ich nicht allein bin. Ich bin offener geworden, für neue Menschen und neue Erfahrungen, und mein Leben fühlt sich heute reicher an als früher.
I'm more balanced, less burnt out, and I know myself better.

I'm much calmer and happier since I've learned to understand my anger. I used to feel guilty all the time for how I treated my family, and that made me depressed. Now I feel more at peace, and I feel a lot of love for my wife and kids. Our home is a much happier place. I understand myself better, especially how my anger is connected to my childhood, and that has helped me be kinder to myself.
Ich bin entspannter und weniger selbstkritisch. Das hat meine Stimmung verbessert, und ich bin zufriedener mit mir und meinem Leben.

My mental health held up much better than I expected during a very difficult few years. I've always been prone to anxiety, and infertility and a high-risk pregnancy are about as anxiety-inducing as it gets. I think the experience gave me a foundation of trust that I didn't have before. I still had anxious times, of course, but I never felt completely lost. Now that our daughter is here, I feel an overwhelming love and gratitude that I can't describe. I appreciate every day with her. I'm also more open to the idea that life doesn't always go according to plan, and that this can be okay. I've become more patient and more accepting, and I think that will help me as a parent. I'm generally a happier and calmer person than I was before the experience.
I'm more confident and less anxious about what people think. I feel freer and happier, and more like myself.

Nach der Erfahrung ging es mir psychisch zunächst schlechter. Ich hatte Panikattacken und war sehr unruhig. Das hat einige Monate gedauert. Mit Hilfe von Atemübungen und Sport habe ich gelernt, damit umzugehen, und heute geht es mir wieder gut. Ich würde sogar sagen, dass ich heute stabiler bin als vor der Erfahrung, weil ich gelernt habe, mit Angst umzugehen. Ich verstehe mich selbst besser und weiß, was ich brauche, wenn es mir nicht gut geht. Aber ich würde die Erfahrung nicht noch einmal machen, weil die Zeit danach wirklich schwer war.
Calmer and less anxious. I feel more stable and grounded.

My mental health has improved a lot since the experience. I was in a bad place before, with symptoms of PTSD that I didn't recognise at the time: nightmares, irritability, drinking too much, feeling numb. I thought it was just part of the job. The experience brought a lot of that to the surface, and since then I've been working through it with a therapist. My nightmares have mostly stopped, I drink much less, and I feel things again. I'm closer to my wife than I've been in years, and I feel a lot of love for her and our kids. I'm also more grateful for my life. I've seen a lot of people lose theirs, and I appreciate mine more now. I'm more open to talking about mental health, which is still a taboo in policing, and I think I've helped a few younger colleagues get support. That gives me a sense of purpose.
Meine Gesundheitsängste sind deutlich zurückgegangen. Ich bin entspannter und kann das Leben mehr genießen, statt mir ständig Sorgen um meinen Körper zu machen.

I'm much less anxious and less self-critical. I understand my mind better, and I can see the difference between what's happening and the stories I tell myself about it. That has made me calmer and happier. I'm also more open to other people's perspectives, because I realise they also have their own stories.
Less anxious about failing, so I'm happier and I try more things. I'm also more curious and open-minded.

Meine psychische Gesundheit hat sich durch die Erfahrung grundlegend verbessert. Ich war damals in einer tiefen Krise, hatte depressive Symptome und fühlte mich wertlos und gescheitert. Ich konnte mich über nichts mehr freuen und hatte kaum noch Hoffnung. Die Erfahrung hat mir gezeigt, dass mein Leben noch viele Möglichkeiten bereithält und dass ich nicht gescheitert bin. Das hat mir neuen Mut gegeben. Heute geht es mir gut. Ich habe eine Ausbildung gefunden, die mich erfüllt, und neue Freunde, die mich unterstützen. Ich bin offener geworden für neue Erfahrungen und habe weniger Angst vor Veränderungen. Vor allem aber bin ich dankbar für mein Leben, für jeden Tag, für die kleinen Freuden. Ich nehme die Welt bewusster wahr und kann mich wieder an Dingen erfreuen, die ich früher übersehen habe, wie einem Sonnenuntergang oder einem guten Gespräch.
I'm more patient, calmer and generally happier. I feel more at peace.

Since quitting weed, my mental health has improved a lot. I'm less foggy, less anxious, and I have more energy. The first few months were hard, but now I feel clearer and more present. I understand myself better too. I see that I was using weed to avoid feelings I didn't want to deal with, and I'm learning to face them instead. My relationship with my girlfriend has improved, and I feel more connected to her.
Ich bin ausgeglichener und weniger gestresst. Ich fühle mich wohler und habe mehr Energie für die Dinge, die mir wichtig sind.

My mental health has improved because I have a deeper sense of meaning. I used to feel empty and depressed, like my life was just a series of chores. Now I feel more connected, to myself, to other people, and to something bigger. I'm more grateful for my life, and I find joy in simple things. I'm also more open to spiritual ideas, which I used to dismiss. I've started reading about Buddhism and I go to a meditation group. I feel a lot more love and peace in my life than I did before.
